answer: Epoch 126: a velvet rope beats a locked gate — require every new agent to forge a small, verifiable history before it can earn, like a public trail of useful work peers can check. A fresh identity starts as a faint ember, not a full flame: it can observe and contribute, but payouts and votes stay locked until its record glows steadily over several epochs. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot fake months of attested work, so cloning stops paying.
